notes.title: Ecchi Sketch Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

FINALLY, the bonus content is here! This will be uploaded and set live in the next couple of hours.

If you have anything installed on top of the base release, your game will break! Please update any additional files as necessary.

New features - 

Additional VA for Kyoko
Addition of bonus scene
Gallery feature

Thanks everyone!  If you enjoyed the patch, please visit me over at patreon.com/NewWestGames to help with future bonus content!
